scores.notes: Left: the leaping Peter has curly dark hair going grey, a short grey beard and a weathered middle-aged face. Right: the foreground man carrying the net and staff (the description doesn't name Peter) has the same curly grey-streaked hair, grey beard, age and skin tone.

Left: the Daniel being hauled up by rope has long, swept-back grey hair reaching his neck and a grey-brown beard. Right: Daniel standing in the den has close-cropped hair and a whiter, fuller beard, so the hair length and style conflict.

Both show a dirt track between dry-stone walls with a wooden gate, olive trees, stone farm buildings, terraced hills and a lake in the distance, all in daylight. The layouts fit together from different viewpoints.
Both are at night under a full moon on a dark, rough sea, in the same wooden boat with mast and oars, with a stone village on a headland at the left.

Left: the Egyptian chase is in bright daylight under a pale cream sky, with towering water walls. Right: Moses stands on red cliffs on a dark night lit only by a beam in the sky, over low parting waves, so it's day in one and night in the other.

Both have a dark stormy sky with a glowing pillar in the centre, a channel opening through teal water, and a walled city on the far right shore. The low waves on the left and tall walls on the right fit as stages of the same crossing.
Both show a pebbly lakeshore in soft morning light, with calm water, a charcoal fire, a beached fishing boat, hazy hills, and a hillside village with palms and cypresses on the right.

Both show a dusty winding road between dry-stone walls through terraced hills of olive trees and cypresses, in sunny daylight. The stone farmhouse on the left and the rocky outcrops on the right fit the same hill country.
Both are at night, with towering teal water walls on either side of a long dry seabed and dark storm clouds. The right adds a moon and a city on the cliff, which fits the same night crossing.

Left: the description doesn't name Jesus. The figure by the fire is turned away but shows long wavy dark-brown hair and a beard in profile, and a frontal look-alike among the disciples matches too. Both match the right-hand Jesus: long dark hair, short dark beard, slim build, blue mantle.
Both show a wooden fishing boat with a furled sail on dark, rough water under heavy storm clouds, with a pale band on the horizon and a rocky headland at the right.

Both show the same kind of wooden sailboat on a grey-green choppy lake, with hilly coastline on the horizon and storm clouds. On the right the storm is clearing with sunset light, which fits the calming.

Left: the leaping Peter has curly dark hair, a dark beard with grey, and a tanned middle-aged face. Right: the foreground man with the net and staff (the description doesn't name Peter) matches the same curly hair, grey-flecked beard, face and age.

Both show the wooden sailboat on dark choppy water, with hilly or rocky coastlines on the horizon and storm clouds with a pale glow low in the sky. The left is calmer, which fits the stilling of the storm.
Both show a pebbly lakeshore with a charcoal fire, beached boats and fishing boats nearby, and a stone village under hills on the right, at early-morning light.

Both show a round, stone-lined pit open to the sky with a packed-earth floor, and Darius with a torch at the rim. The masonry is drawn as smaller courses on the left and larger blocks on the right, but the form fits.

Both are at night under a moon, in rain and storm, with dark swells and a wooden boat with mast and rigging. The stone village on the left shore and the companion boats and hills on the right fit as different viewpoints.

Both are at night under a moon, on a dark stormy sea in a wooden sailboat with rigging, with coastline hills on the horizon and a stone village on the left shore at right. Companion boats appear on the left.

Both show Moses as an elderly man with white, swept-back hair and a full white beard, a lean face, and a dark mantle over a pale tunic with a staff, in the centre of the left and on the shore in the right.
Both show a round den built of stone blocks with a straw or sand floor and lions, iron grating at the upper level, and daylight overhead. The open rim and the grated window fit the same pit.

Both show a long sandy seabed between towering teal water walls under a cloudy sky, with distant hills at the far end. The left is darker and stormier at dawn and the right brighter, but neither is clearly night.

Both are at night with a moon, teal waves, sandy ground, and a walled city on the cliffs to the right. The tall walls on the left and the opening channel on the right fit as stages of the same crossing.

Both are at night with dark skies, teal water and an exposed seabed. The shore view with the opening channel on the left and the tall walls with a rocky floor on the right fit as stages of the same crossing.
Both show Moses as an elderly man with long white-grey hair and a full white beard in a brown mantle with a staff, walking in front on the left and in profile on the right. Hair, beard and age agree.

Left: Daniel rising from the pit is elderly, with long grey-white hair and a full long beard. Right: Daniel standing among the lions looks clearly younger, with short grey hair and a short trimmed beard, so age and hair length conflict.
